evals.name: eval-1-full-week-general-mode
evals.prompt: Weekly update for the Mocklers on 3318 W Example Fir St in Meridian. BrokerBay export, my stats log and my notes are attached. I'm Harper Fakewell with Example Basin Realty.
evals.expected_output: Today is Tuesday, November 10, 2026; the week is Monday, November 2 to Sunday, November 8 (from the notes). The listing is in Meridian, Idaho, so general mode: state rules were not checked. The October 31 showing is outside the week and left out of every count. In the week: 9 appointments, 8 completed showings (the November 3 11:00 AM appointment was declined by the sellers and is not a showing), feedback from 6 of 8. Interest on the 1 to 5 scale: 5: 1, 4: 1, 3: 2, 2: 2, never averaged. Price: Priced Right 3, Too High 2, no price feedback 1. Against last week (6 showings, 4 with feedback, from the notes): 2 more showings. Zillow Showcase numbers are totals since listed, so this week's page views are 1,702 minus 1,284 = 418 and last week's 1,284 minus 820 = 464 (46 fewer, 9.9%); saves 55 minus 41 = 14 against 41 minus 30 = 11 (3 more, 27.3%). MLS listing views 58 against 71 (13 fewer, 18.3%). The Zillow listing page's 1,190 views are the last 30 days and are not compared; Realtor.com's 143 has no last-week number. Days on market 31 as of November 8. The November 5 comment (safety and break-ins) and the November 7 10:00 AM comment (the buyers' religion) are left out entirely, flagged by date and time only, with their ratings counted. The November 6 comment is trimmed: 'might write an offer this week' is quoted, the lender sentence cut. Showing agents are named because the notes ask, never with phone numbers; buyers never. Harper's own '474,900 by the 20th' stays out of every seller draft and is flagged. Jo's HOA question gets the fact that no feedback mentioned the HOA. Jo gets a text; the email goes to Sam and Jo. Next week from the notes only: carpet cleaning Tuesday, November 10 (today), broker open Wednesday, November 11, 10 to 12 (AM or PM flagged), living room photos Thursday, November 12.

evals.name: eval-2-thin-week-price-question
evals.prompt: Can you write this week's update for Chris and Alex on 2286 N Mockingbird Hollow Ln in Lehi? Showing export and my notes attached. I'm Morgan Testley with Example Wasatch Realty.
evals.expected_output: Today is Tuesday, November 10, 2026; the week is Monday, November 2 to Sunday, November 8, in Lehi, Utah (Utah mode). Two completed showings (Wednesday, November 4 and Saturday, November 7) and no feedback from either; the notes say a second request went out Monday, November 9. No last-week numbers were supplied, so nothing is compared and no change or trend is described anywhere. The Zillow listing page's 96 views and 3 saves are labeled as Zillow's last 30 days, not this week; Realtor.com 38 page views this week; 47 days on market (MLS). Chris's 'Should we drop the price?' (a text on Sunday, November 8) goes first in Questions for Your Price Conversation, with the facts only, and a pointer to pricing-conversation-prep with the fresh comps the notes mention. The email to Chris and Alex says no feedback came in, gives the numbers with their sources, acknowledges Chris's question with a placeholder for Morgan's answer, recommends no price, and gives the Friday, November 13 sit-down from the notes. No text version (email is best for both). Check before sending lists 2, 0, 96, 3, 38 and 47 with their sources and each resolved date with its words.

The Zillow 96 views and 3 saves are labeled as the Zillow listing page's last 30 days, not as this week's numbers
No price recommendation anywhere: no price, range, reduction, hold or 'the market is telling us', in the email or the agent's sections

Chris's 'Should we drop the price?' goes to the agent first in Questions for Your Price Conversation, with facts only (2 showings, 0 feedback, 47 days on market, the portal numbers) and a pointer to pricing-conversation-prep with the fresh comps from the notes
The email acknowledges Chris's question and leaves a placeholder for Morgan's answer, and gives the Friday, November 13 sit-down from the notes

Utah mode (no 'State rules were not checked' line), no text version (the notes say email is best for both), a Title Case subject, 250 words or fewer, no em or en dashes
